button.$description:
The button box and the reactive label. The components in packages/react/src/ carry no dimensions of their own, so changing the box here changes every button.

The four width stages are a floor (`min-width`), so a longer translation is never clipped. The height is what an ordinary text field measures (`px-3 py-1.5 text-sm`: a 20px line box plus 12px of padding), so a button beside a field matches it.

btn-h-transport.$description: Only for the transport squares of a head bar; see `.glim-btn-transport`.
